description: Runs the drift check once at the end of every turn, so a diagram that has stopped matching the code says so without anyone remembering to ask. Quiet when nothing is wrong. Exits immediately, before starting node, in a project with no diagrams. At session start, says in one line whether a board server is still running; silent, and node-free, when none is.

SessionStart.//: startup and resume only: after /clear or a compaction the session is the same one, and the line would repeat itself.

Stop.//: Stop is documented to ignore matchers while the plugin-dev validator rejects a hook without one; "*" satisfies both. See docs/drift-check.md.
